reason: A dsh plugin that provides configurable browser sound notifications when sessions request approval, ask a question, or finish a turn.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 会话在需要审批、等待用户回答或完成时播放可配置的浏览器声音提示。
summaries.en: Provides configurable browser sound alerts when a dsh session requests approval, asks a question, or finishes a turn.

capabilities: Monitors session-list state changes for approval requests, user questions, and finished turns
Reads configured local audio files on the dsh web host and serves them to the browser
Registers and reads an audio-alert settings namespace
